sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 180.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 20 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies 30% concentration for 150 seconds.
